Knocket is a free, multi-channel customer communication platform that lets businesses and creators meet users wherever they reach out, web, mobile, or a simple link, and keep every conversation in one calm inbox. It offers three main surfaces: a Web Widget that installs with a single script tag on any site (WordPress, Shopify, React, etc.), a Contact Page (a shareable live-chat landing page at knocket.ai/yourhandle), and a Mobile Widget for native-feeling support inside iOS and Android apps. All messages flow into a single inbox, and replies can be sent directly from Telegram without tab switching. An optional AI agent can answer routine questions using uploaded docs and FAQs, then hand off to a human when needed. Every message pings Telegram. Quote-reply lands in the user's in-app chat.

Screenshots, screen recordings, logs — synced into your inbox.

Online: live chat. Offline: lead form — same thread resumes on return.

### Custom user tags

Pass user\_id, email, tags — same user across sessions and devices.

Two-way read receipts. Recall mistyped messages either side.

A star rating says something's wrong — not what. Knocket lets users tap Help and talk to a real human in 5 seconds. Retention grows because someone actually replied.
